rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate now satisfies the prior instruction by constraining each nltl:shaftLineLoadCaseType value with sh:class nltl:shaftLineLoadCaseTypeValue while retaining the controlled alternatives and owner/path structure. It also covers the declared operands, result, relationships, load-case-specific inclusive safety-factor minima, datatypes, and units within the COMPLEX_READINESS boundary. No vocabulary matcher is required.
